name: Leonteq AG
summary: Leonteq AG provides derivative investment products and services in Switzerland, Europe, and Asia, and internationally. It offers structured products, such as capital protection products, yield enhancement products, participation products, leverage products, equities and equity indices, currencies, crypto assets, fund derivatives, quantitative investment strategies, and exchange traded products, as well as Islamic banking and finance services.
